# The topology bar's hidden readout still takes space and wraps the bar

## Context

#17844's census at dev@cce07cdade (2026-09-13) lists five Workstation Neural Link arms red that were green or skipped at dev@22c183ccf9 on the same host. All five follow from one layout change. In the census's 800×600 headless window, where the Workstation's inner size is 756×469, the topology bar now wraps onto a second row and takes 40px from the dock.

| head | topology bar | dock host | readout box |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22c183ccf9 | 43px | 328px | none |
| f9709716ad | 83px, two rows | 288px | 20×12px, hidden |

## The Problem

At this width the bar's content box is 732px: 756px less `--toolbar-padding: 6px 12px` (#18560). The row needs 746px: Save 159, Close 165, Reset 175, readout 20, Undo 96 and Redo 95, plus six 6px gaps (the action spacer has no basis). So Redo wraps.

26px of that row is the readout, which has nothing to say at boot. It hides by toggling `neo-hidden` (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:475`), and `neo-hidden` is `visibility: hidden` (`resources/scss/src/Global.scss:116`), so its 20px padding box and its gap stay in the flex line. Without them the row needs 720px and fits.

Two one-row controls ran at dev@5dc6b80fef on the same host, each running the three spec files whole plus a bar probe. The only change between f9709716ad and that head is #18649, which touches comments, a guide and the docs SEO script.

| arm | 22c183ccf9 | f9709716ad | bar `wrap: 'nowrap'` | readout `hidden` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` large-over-small ×2 (`:1585`) | skipped | failed | skipped | skipped |
| `WorkstationPopOutSparklinesNL` (`:68`) | passed | failed | passed | passed |
| `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL` film and plain pace (`:1017`, `:1022`) | passed | failed | passed | passed |
| bar / dock host | 43 / 328px | 83 / 288px | 45 / 326px | 45 / 326px |

`nowrap` gets its row by shrinking every button (Save 159→155px). Hiding the readout keeps every button at its natural width. This is the defect #18016 fixed for the toolbar rail: a withdrawn element takes no space.

## The Architectural Reality

- The readout is a view-owned component in the view-declared bar (`Workspace.createTopologyBar`). Its `cls` and `html` bindings both go through `Workspace.topologyStateText`, so visibility and text cannot disagree.
- Hiding belongs to `Neo.component.Base`: `hidden` with the default `hideMode_: 'removeDom'` (`src/component/Base.mjs:148`) keeps the vdom node and removes its DOM, while `'visibility'` is the opt-in that keeps the box. The class toggle reproduces that opt-in by accident.
- `WorkspaceController.syncTopologyBar` inserts two recovery buttons per popup ahead of the action spacer, so at narrow widths the bar needs `wrap: 'wrap'`. The wrap is not the defect.

## The Fix

Bind `hidden` to the same formatter, `hidden: data => !Workspace.topologyStateText(lineState(data))`, keep `workstation-topology-state` as a static `cls`, and drop the `neo-hidden` toggle.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With nothing to say, the readout is hidden and its DOM removed; with text, it renders that text.
- [ ] A unit arm pins both states and fails on dev.
- [ ] The three spec files, run whole at the PR head with the Brain runtime, report the 22c results above. The #16756 arm (`:669`) stays red on its 1200px display requirement, as it is at both heads.
- [ ] #17844's current-state block attributes the five arms to this fix.

## Out of Scope

- Once the readout shows text, its box alone exceeds the 12px the row has left, so at this width the bar still wraps while the readout speaks. Truncating the readout instead is a separate design question.
- `wrap: 'wrap'` itself, and the #16756 display requirement.

Decision Record impact: none.
